# Version 4.147.0
> **v4 preview foundations** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.147.0-preview.3.1)

> **Superseded by [4.148.0](4.148.0.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 4.148.0.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.147.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.6/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.147.0 previews the v4 engine update with variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, and new surface-draw sampling. This preview moves the bundled renderer through Skia m147, adds zero-copy stream data access, and expands platform support. It begins the v4 breaking-change transition, including a Vulkan YCbCr type rename and changed equality support.

## Breaking Changes

- **Vulkan YCbCr conversion info type renamed** — GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo now uses GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo instead of GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo. Update references to the renamed type and replace uses of its removed equality interface and equality operators with explicit field comparisons where needed.

## Engine

- **Skia upgraded through milestone m147** — The bundled Skia engine advances from m132 through m147, bringing upstream rendering fixes and improvements across supported platforms. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp add variable-font support, while SKFont and SKTypeface gain color-palette selection and more robust variable-font handling. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))

## API Surface

- **Sampling options for surface drawing** — New SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface overloads accept SKSamplingOptions, so callers can choose filtering and mipmap behavior for surface-to-surface draws. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream data** — SKWebpEncoder can produce animated WebP files, and SKStream.GetData converts a seekable stream to SKData without an intermediate byte array. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771), [#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **HarfBuzz color and wrapper APIs** — HarfBuzzSharp adds an HBColor value type and fills in missing or inconsistently named binding wrappers. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **SKPath finalizer ordering crash fixed** — Finalization no longer crashes when an SKPathBuilder is collected before an SKPath created from it. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Android SKGLView survives MAUI tab changes** — SKGLView is reattached correctly after a MAUI TabBar view switch, preventing a blank rendering surface. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))

## Platform

- **New Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen native assets** — Android-hosted Linux is supported through linux-bionic assets, and Tizen gains x64 and arm64 native builds. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **Updated Apple target framework alignment** — Libraries target versioned Apple TFMs while sample apps use unversioned TFMs, aligning the packages with current .NET SDK guidance. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))
- **WASM now requires .NET 8 or later** — Pre-.NET 8 Emscripten native runtime assets are no longer included in SkiaSharp WASM packages. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))

## Security

- **Bundled native dependencies refreshed** — The release updates libexpat, libpng, zlib, FreeType, and libjpeg-turbo to newer upstream versions. ([#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6

HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6 includes variable-font and color-palette support, the HBColor value type, and additional binding wrappers.
